description: Local stdio MCP server that proxies crawl4ai (markdown, html, screenshot, pdf, execute_js, crawl, ask) to a configured crawl4ai REST instance and writes resulting artifacts to an agent-specified directory.
name: io.github.magicxor/Crawl4AiMcp

environmentVariables.name: Crawl4Ai__BaseUrl
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the crawl4ai REST instance (e.g. http://localhost:11235).

environmentVariables.name: Crawl4Ai__ApiToken
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token (CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN) for the crawl4ai instance. Leave empty for unauthenticated loopback instances.

environmentVariables.name: Crawl4Ai__TimeoutSeconds
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for crawl4ai requests (default 300).

environmentVariables.name: Crawl4Ai__AllowedOutputPatterns__0
environmentVariables.description: First regex in the output-directory allow-list (case-insensitive). Add __1, __2, ... for more. An empty allow-list denies ALL writes, so at least one pattern is required for any tool to save files. Example: ^C:\\Users\\me\\crawl-out(\\|$)
